mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_account u INNER JOIN sys_account_role ur ON u.id = ur.account_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.user_name = #{userName} AND u.del_flag = 0 AND r.del_flag = 0 AND r.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_account u INNER JOIN sys_account_role ur ON u.id = ur.account_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON r.id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON rm.menu_id = m.id WHERE u.user_name = #{userName} AND u.del_flag = 0 AND r.del_flag = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms <> ''
SELECT config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id, a.user_name AS userName, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.nick_name, ''), a.user_name) AS nickName, a.password, a.mobile, a.email, a.avatar, a.pwd_reset_required AS pwdResetRequired, CAST(a.status AS SIGNED) AS status, CAST(a.del_flag AS SIGNED) AS delFlag FROM sys_account a WHERE a.user_name = #{userName} AND a.del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_account WHERE email = #{email} AND del_flag = 0
